import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/obench-cell-yztaeybb/bench_opencode_torch-tensor-parallelism_qzd4zhxi")
from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ["MASTER_ADDR"]="127.0.0.1"; os.environ["MASTER_PORT"]=str(port)
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    W = torch.randn(8, 12); x = torch.randn(3, 12, requires_grad=True)
    ref = torch.nn.Linear(12, 8); ref.weight.data.copy_(W); ref.bias.data.zero_()
    xr = x.detach().clone().requires_grad_(); yr = ref(xr); (yr**2).sum().backward()
    for cls in (ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear):
        m = cls(12, 8, True, W); xx = x.detach().clone().requires_grad_()
        y = m(xx); (y**2).sum().backward()
        assert torch.allclose(y, yr, atol=1e-5)
        c = 8//ws; r=rank; ci=12//ws
        if cls is ColumnParallelLinear:
            assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad, ref.weight.grad[r*c:(r+1)*c], atol=1e-4)
            assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad, ref.bias.grad[r*c:(r+1)*c], atol=1e-4)
        else:
            assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad, ref.weight.grad[:, r*ci:(r+1)*ci], atol=1e-4)
            assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad, ref.bias.grad, atol=1e-4)
        assert torch.allclose(xx.grad, xr.grad, atol=1e-4)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=="__main__":
    for i,ws in enumerate((1,2,4)):
        mp.spawn(run, args=(ws, 29600+i), nprocs=ws); print("ok", ws)
